description: This file contains internal implementation details for JSON decoding in Kubernetes, including type aliases, configuration functions, error handling, and strict decoding error types.

classes.name: strictError
classes.description: Represents a strict decoding error with error type and field path.

classes.name: UnmarshalStrictError
classes.description: Holds multiple strict decoding errors resulting from strict decoder directives.

methods.name: UseNumber
methods.description: Configures the decoder to decode numbers as json.Number.

methods.name: DisallowUnknownFields
methods.description: Configures the decoder to treat unknown fields as errors.

methods.name: CaseSensitive
methods.description: Requires JSON keys to exactly match struct tags or field names.

methods.name: PreserveInts
methods.description: Decodes numbers as int64 when possible, falling back to float64.

methods.name: DisallowDuplicateFields
methods.description: Treats duplicate fields as errors during decoding.

methods.name: newFieldError
methods.description: Creates a new strictError for a specific field and error type.

methods.name: saveStrictError
methods.description: Saves a strictError, deduplicating and limiting the number stored.

methods.name: appendStrictFieldStackKey
methods.description: Appends a key to the strict field stack for error reporting.

methods.name: appendStrictFieldStackIndex
methods.description: Appends an index to the strict field stack for error reporting.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the strictError.

methods.name: FieldPath
methods.description: Returns the field path of the strictError.

methods.name: SetFieldPath
methods.description: Sets the field path of the strictError.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns a string representation of UnmarshalStrictError.
